testCases.input: How can we reduce high energy consumption during peak hours?
testCases.actualOutput: Prioritize immediate investigation of the highest-consuming periods or equipment and reduce avoidable energy loads where possible. Because the case occurs during a peak period, consider shifting flexible loads to lower-demand periods.
